topics.title: USSF-259 tonight — Vandenberg window 8pm CT
topics.why: Falcon 9 classified USSF from SLC-4E; window opens Tue Sep 15 8:00pm CT (6:00pm PT), backup Wed Sep 16 same time; B1097 13th flight, OCISLY. Not yet launched as of morning brief.

topics.title: Flight 14 tracker NET slipped to Sep 22
topics.why: Spaceflight Now (updated Sep 14) lists Starship Flight 14 NET Sep 22, window opens 7:15am CT; delayed from Sep 15 and 18. Still no official SpaceX T-0. Yesterday's brief had FAA ATC planning Sep 18.
